forecast.method: Lokaal niveau + seizoenspatroon op de log-prijs (exponentiële afvlakking)
forecast.band: 10-90% van de fouten in een backtest over de laatste 36 maanden

suppliers.name: Luminus
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter; supplier energy price, including 6% VAT; October 2026 tariff card.
suppliers.notes: Residential Flanders variable product. The card also publishes separate peak/off-peak prices for a dual meter and a variable injection tariff.

suppliers.name: Engie

suppliers.name: Eneco
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter; estimated annual energy price on the October 2026 card, including 6% VAT. The card also shows a monthly estimate of 20.78 eurocent/kWh.
suppliers.notes: Variable price indexed monthly to Belpex-RLP-M. The tariff card is valid from 1 October through 31 October 2026 for residential customers in Flanders and Wallonia.

suppliers.name: TotalEnergies
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter; monthly indicative supplier energy price for October 2026, including 6% VAT; exact variable index is finalized after the delivery month.
suppliers.notes: Residential Flanders product for meters read annually. The card also publishes an estimated annual price of 22.38 eurocent/kWh and a BELPEX_M_RLP formula.

suppliers.name: Mega
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Official October 2026 offer page found, but the numeric current tariff card requires the postcode/product simulation and was not independently confirmed.
suppliers.notes: No exact numeric tariff values were retained because the current official tariff card was not independently confirmed before being blocked.

suppliers.name: Bolt
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: No current Belgian residential electricity tariff card or pricing page could be confirmed on Bolt's official domain.
suppliers.notes: No official source URL or numbers are included because a real current Belgian energy offer could not be verified.

suppliers.name: Elegant
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Official current-offer page lists Flex, but its numeric card is calculator/customer-zone driven; the public archive exposed only older 2026 cards during this lookup.
suppliers.notes: No exact current October 2026 numeric values were retained. Older January/February values should not be substituted.

suppliers.name: Energyvision
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Mixed product: first 1,800 kWh are fixed at 0.1060 EUR/kWh; consumption above 1,800 kWh is variable at 0.2004 EUR/kWh on the October 2026 card. Not a single pure mono variable rate.
suppliers.notes: Residential Flanders product, including 6% VAT. The variable component is monthly indexed by formula; the product framing does not cleanly fit a standard variable mono comparison row.

suppliers.name: OCTA+
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter; estimated average supplier energy price for the coming 12 months on the October 2026 card, including VAT.
suppliers.notes: Residential Flanders variable one-year product. The card warns that activated SMR3/AMR digital-meter configurations may be billed dynamically instead.

suppliers.name: Aspiravi
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter; September 2026 realized/reference energy cost shown on the October 2026 tariff card, including 6% VAT. October's final variable price is only known after the month ends.
suppliers.notes: Residential variable product for contracts starting or renewing from 1 October through 31 December 2026. The card publishes the formula 0.116 x Belpex + 2 c€/kWh excl. VAT for the mono meter and restricts supply to eligible co-operators.

suppliers.name: Frank Energie
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: 24u/digital meter; expected October 2026 variable energy price under the official VNR estimate, including 6% VAT.
suppliers.notes: Variable formula is (0.1068 x Belpex RLP_BE + 1.500) x 1.06 EURct/kWh. The official card calls the standing charge an abonnementskost and publishes it per month.

suppliers.name: Luminus
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter, incl. 6% BTW ('Luminus energieprijzen (incl. BTW)'), card '(oktober 2026)', Regio: Vlaanderen. Quote: 'Geleverde energie (c€/kWh) 20,50 23,25 18,05 18,05'; header 'Tarief: vast ... Duur van het contract: 2 jaar'
suppliers.notes: Quote: 'Vaste vergoeding (€/jaar) 25,00'. Online-only product. Alternative fixed product: Luminus Comfy Elektriciteit (oktober 2026, 'Tarief: vast', 1 jaar): 23,90 c€/kWh enkelvoudig, vaste vergoeding 65,00 €/jaar, 30% welkomstkorting op energiekost 12 maanden (documentSlug=comfy).

suppliers.name: Engie
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudig, Afname, incl. 6% btw, 'Vaste prijzen elektriciteit voor contracten afgesloten in Oktober 2026 (looptijd van 1 jaar)', Vlaamse Gewest. Quote: 'Afname(2) 23,100'
suppliers.notes: Quote: 'Vaste vergoeding(1) 69,00 €/jaar'. Also Engie Empower (Type : Vast), onbepaalde duur, Oct 2026: 22,243 c€/kWh enkelvoudig, 90,00 €/jaar (document=E_EMPOWER_R_GREEN_C_F_00_V_N). The monthOffset=0 API URL always serves the current month's card.

suppliers.name: Eneco
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter, incl. 6% btw, 'Tariefkaart oktober 2026', 'Geldig van 1 oktober 2026 t.e.m uiterlijk 31 oktober 2026', Vlaanderen en Wallonië. Quote row: '65,00   21,69   24,69   19,08' (vaste vergoeding, enkelvoudig, dag, nacht)
suppliers.notes: 'contract van bepaalde duur met een looptijd van 1 jaar'. Also Eneco Zon & Wind Vast (BC_032_012610_NL_ENECO_POWER_FIX.pdf): 22,10 c€/kWh, 65,00 €/jaar, 'contract van onbepaalde duur waarbij de energieprijs vast is tijdens het eerste jaar'. Energiedelen admin cost 124,63 €/jaar/EAN extra if applicable.

suppliers.name: TotalEnergies
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter, BTW 6% inbegrepen, 'Tariefkaart ... oktober 2026', Vlaamse Gewest. Quote row: '35,00   21,93   23,71   20,38   20,88   Jaarlijkstarief'; 'De energieprijs voor verbruik is vast tijdens de contractperiode.'
suppliers.notes: Contract 'van onbepaalde duur'; price guaranteed not to rise for the first 12 months ('zal de energieprijzen ... de eerste 12 maanden van de levering niet verhogen'), so duration_months=12 is the fixed-price period, not a term. Other Oct 2026 fixed cards: myComfort Vast (1 jaar) 22,74 c€/kWh + 90,00 €/jaar (MYCOMFORT-FIXED_ELECTRICITY_VL_NL.pdf); Elektriciteit Vast (1 jaar) 22,74 c€/kWh + 100,00 €/jaar (ELECTRICITE-FIXE_ELECTRICITY_VL_NL.pdf). Boilerplate on these cards still says 'De variabele energieprijs en de vaste vergoeding' in section 1.1, contradicting the 'vast' statement - template artefact.

suppliers.name: OCTA+
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Enkelvoudige meter, INCL. BTW, 'TARIEFFICHE SEPTEMBER 2026' (latest published; no October card at this URL), residentieel Vlaanderen. Quote: 'Enkelvoudige meter 18,38' (AFNAME Vast)
suppliers.notes: Quote: 'Vaste vergoeding (€/jaar) 65,00'. 'Duurtijd Onbepaald' with 'Gegarandeerde vaste prijs gedurende minimum 12 maanden' -> indefinite contract, price fixed >=12 months. Promo: creditnota 180 € after a full year. Also OCTA+ EcoFixed (Sept 2026): 20,82 c€/kWh, 130,00 €/jaar (E_OCTA_ECOFIXED_RE_VL_NL.pdf).

suppliers.name: Bolt

suppliers.name: Energyvision
suppliers.price_per_kwh_note: Single afname price (card does not split by meter type), 'Alle prijzen en tarieven zijn inclusief 6% BTW', 'Tariefkaart oktober 2026', particulieren in Vlaanderen. Quote: 'Groene stroom - vast tarief 13,57 €cent/kWh'
suppliers.notes: Quote: 'Vaste vergoeding 75 €/jaar'; 'contract van bepaalde duur van 3 jaar waarbij de energieprijs vast is'. Unusually low price - double-check before relying on it. Other product 'Goedkope stroom 1.800 kWh vast' (10-year contract) is only partly fixed (10,60 c€/kWh for first 1.800 kWh, 20,04 variable above) - not a pure fixed tariff.
